risks.risk: The tabletop material may be MDF with a laminate sticker rather than real marble or sintered stone.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the edge and the underside of the tabletop.

risks.risk: The base may be painted wood or plastic rather than metal.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of a joint or a video of the base being tapped to hear the material.

risks.risk: The tables may be unstable or wobbly due to the curved base design.
risks.proof: A video showing the tables being pushed to test for stability.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the tabletop edge and underside to confirm material.
Close-up photo of the base joints.
Video showing the stability of the tables when weight is applied or when pushed.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a decorative coffee table set. It can be priced at its worst-case material quality (laminate top and non-metal base) based on the single provided photo.
